sections.title: To the saints who are in Ephesus

verses.text: By the will of God, our Lord Jesus Christ, the Apostle, to the saints who are in Ephesus,
Grace and peace be unto you from God our Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ.
Blessed be our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father, God, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus.
Before the world was created, we have chosen Him, who is holy, pure, and without sin, to act in love towards us.
In Jesus Christ, according to His beloved will, He has predestined us to be His children.
Let us give glory for the grace bestowed upon us, as He has given it to His beloved Son.
In Him, according to His mercy, we have obtained redemption through His blood; our sins have been forgiven.
This is indeed the wisdom and counsel that He has abundantly provided for us.
As He has chosen us, He has revealed to us the mystery of His will.
He has appointed the time that will come; let all that is in heaven and on earth rejoice, for Christ is above all.
According to His will, He works all things; as He has thought, we have received an inheritance in Him.
This is the hope that He has given us in Christ Jesus, that we may be for His glory a source of praise.
And you, having heard and believed the word of truth which you were taught, may you be sealed with the Holy Spirit, in whom you have placed your hope.
This is indeed the glory of our Lord, the inheritance of our heritage, and the abundance of our life.

sections.title: Concerning the remembrance of the faithful.

verses.text: Therefore, I have heard of your faith in our Lord Jesus Christ and of your love for all the saints,
I do not cease to give thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers.
That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you the Spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Him,
That the eyes of your understanding may be enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of His calling, and what are the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,
And what is the exceeding greatness of His power toward us who believe, according to the working of His mighty power,
Which He worked in Christ when He raised Him from the dead and seated Him at His right hand in the heavenly places,
Far above all principality and power and might and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in that which is to come.
And He put all things under His feet and gave Him to be head over all things to the church,
Which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.
እናንተም በኀጢአታችሁ ምውታን ሆናችሁ ነበር።
ይኸውም ቀድሞ በዚህ ዓለም ሥርዐት፥ አሁን በከሓድያን ልጆች የሚበረታታባቸውና፥ በነፋስ አምሳል የሚገዛቸው አለቃ እንደ ነበረው ፈቃድ ጸንታችሁ የነበራችሁበት ነው።
እኛ ሁላችን ቀድሞ እንደ ሥጋችን ምኞት ኖርን፤ የሥጋችንንም ፈቃድና ያሰብነውን አደረግን፤ እንደ ሌሎች ኃጥአንም ሁሉ የጥፋት ልጆች ሆንን።
እግዚአብሔር ግን በምሕረቱ ባለጸግነትና በወደደን በፍቅሩ ብዛት፥
በኃጢአታችን የሞትን ሳለን በክርስቶስ ሕይወትን ሰጠን፤ በጸጋውም ዳንን።
በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም አስነሥቶ በሰማያት ከእርሱ ጋር አኖረን።
በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ይቅር ስላለን የጸጋውን ባለጠግነት ብዛት በሚመጣው ዓለም ይገልጥ ዘንድ፥
አምነን በጸጋው ድነናልና፤ ይህም የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው እንጂ የእናንተ ሥራ አይደለም።
የሚመካም እንዳይኖር በምግባራችን አይደለም።
እንመላለስበት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ ላዘጋጀው በጎ ሥራ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የፈጠረን ፍጥረቱ ነንና።

sections.title: He who has made the two one, peace.

verses.text: You, the Gentiles, remember; formerly you were in the flesh, you were called the uncircumcised by those who are called the circumcised, which is done in the flesh by human hands.
At that time, you did not know Christ; you were separate from the law of Israel; you were strangers to the covenant of promise; you had no hope, and in this world, you did not know God.
But now, you who were once far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
For He Himself is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of separation.
By abolishing in His flesh the enmity, that is, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, so as to create in Himself one new man from the two, thus making peace.
And He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
For through Him we both have access by one Spirit to the Father.
Now, therefore, you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of the household of God.
Having been built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ Himself being the chief cornerstone.
He is the one who holds all creation, and the house of the Lord is the place where He dwells.
You are to be the dwelling place of the Holy Spirit of God; in Him, you shall be set free.
ስለዚህ አሕዛብ ሆይ ስለ እናንተ እኔ ጳውሎስ የክርስቶስ እስረኛው ነኝ።
ስለ እናንተ የሰጠኝን የእግዚአብሔርን የጸጋውን ስጦታ ሰምታችኋል።
አስቀድሞ በጥቂቱ እንደ ጻፍሁላችሁ ይህን ምሥጢር ገልጦ አሳይቶኛልና።
ይህንም በምታነቡበት ጊዜ፥ የክርስቶስን ምሥጢር ማስተዋሌን ለማወቅ ትችላላችሁ።
በሌላ ዘመን ለሰው ልጆች ያልተገለጠ ዛሬ ለቅዱሳን ሐዋርያቱና ለነቢያቱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ እንደ ተገለጠ፥
አሕዛብን ወራሾቹና አካሉ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ፥ በወንጌልም ትምህርት በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በሆነው ተስፋ አንድ ይሆኑ ዘንድ።
በኀይሉ አጋዥነት እንደ ሰጠኝ እንደ ጸጋው ስጦታ መጠን እኔ መልእክተኛና አዋጅ ነጋሪ የሆንሁለት፥
ከቅዱሳን ሁሉ ለማንስ ለእኔ የማይመረመረውን የክርስቶስን ባለጸግነት ለአሕዛብ አስተምር ዘንድ ይህን ጸጋ ሰጠኝ።
ሁሉን በፈጠረ በእግዚአብሔር ከዘለዓለም የተሰወረ የዚህ ምሥጢር ሥርዐትንም ለሁሉ እገልጥ ዘንድ፤
ብዙ ልዩ ልዩ የሆነች የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ አሁን በቤተ ክርስቲያን በኩል በሰማያዊ ስፍራ ውስጥ ላሉት አለቆችና ሥልጣናት ትታወቅ ዘንድ፤
ዓለም ሳይፈጠር የወሰናት፥ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም የፈጸማት፥
እኛ ጸጋንና ባለሟልነትን ያገኘንበት፥ በሃይማኖት ወደሚገኘው ተስፋም ያደረሰበት፤
ስለዚህም ስለ እናንተ ለክብራችሁ የምታገኘኝን መከራዬን ቸል እንዳይላት እግዚአብሔርን እማልደዋለሁ።
Therefore, I shall bless the Lord with all my heart.
All things in heaven and on earth shall be called upon Him;
As He is Lord, may He grant you what you ask, and by the Holy Spirit may He strengthen you.
In your hearts, let love be the foundation, for Christ shall dwell within the hearts of men through faith.
As to the breadth and length, the depth and height, how great it is, you are able to comprehend with all the saints;
To know the love of Christ, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
According to His riches in glory, may He supply all your needs, and may He grant you strength to endure.
To Him be glory in the church through Christ Jesus, throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
Brethren, I, Paul, who am a prisoner of Christ, beseech you to walk worthy of the calling with which you were called.
With all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
endeavoring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
I implore you to be of one body and one spirit, as you were called in one hope of your calling.
There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
one God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
To each one of us grace was given according to the measure of Christ's gift.
"He ascended on high, led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men."
What is the ascent if He did not descend into the lower parts of the earth?
He who descended is also the One who ascended far above all the heavens, that He might fill all things.
And He granted grace; from the household of the apostles, and from them the prophets and the ministers of the gospel, the guardians and the teachers, He called.
That the saints may be equipped for the work of service and for the building up of the body of Christ;
That we all may come to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a perfect man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;
Therefore, in their humility, let them be mindful of those who are being taught, as we are all being nurtured and raised up in the breath of teaching, and let us not neglect the children.
But rather, let us be true in love, growing up in all things into Him who is the head, even Christ.

From Him, the whole body, joined and knit together by what every joint supplies, according to the effective working by which every part does its share, causes growth of the body for the edifying of itself in love.
Therefore, I say unto you, let not your hearts be filled with vain thoughts, as the nations do; I shall also beseech the Lord.
Their hearts are hardened; they are separated from the life which God gives, through their stubbornness and their blindness.
They are those who have lost hope; they have given themselves over to deceit, to wickedness, and to destruction.
But you, who have learned Christ, are not so.
Indeed, as you have heard, truth is in Jesus Christ, and you are taught to know the truth in Him.
Cast off your former self, for I speak of this error that arises from the desire that leads to the corruption of the old man.
Renew your understanding in your hearts.
And let the Lord, in truth, righteousness, and holiness, clothe you with the new man.
Therefore, cast away falsehood; let each of you speak truth with his neighbor, for we are all one body.
Be angry, but do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger.
Do not give a way to the devil.
Let him who steals no longer steal; rather, let him labor, doing good with his hands, that he may have something to share with him who is in need.
Whatever good you hear, may you receive it, but let no evil word proceed from your mouth, except that which is good for necessary edification.
In the time of your trial, do not grieve the holy spirit of God, in whom you were sealed.
Put away from yourselves all bitterness and wrath, anger and clamor, and all malice; be rid of all evil things.
Be kind and tenderhearted to one another; and forgive one another, even as God in Christ forgave you.
Therefore, as beloved children, be imitators of God.
Just as Christ loved you, and gave Himself for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling aroma, so also walk in love.
But fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness must not even be named among you, as is fitting for saints.
Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor coarse jesting, which are not fitting, but rather giving of thanks should be among you.
For this you know, that no fornicator, unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
Therefore do not be partakers with them.
For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light.
For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
And find out what is acceptable to the Lord.
The fruit of labor is not to be associated with those who dwell in darkness; rather, let your light shine upon them.
For the work done in secret is that which brings forth the opportunity to speak.
However, all that is made manifest in the light shall be known; for all that is seen is light.
"Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light," it is said.
Therefore, be vigilant, not as unwise but as wise, considering how you may walk.
For the days are evil; therefore, redeem the time.
Therefore, do not be foolish; but understand what the will of the Lord is.
Do not be drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Holy Spirit.
Speak to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs; sing and make melody in your heart to the Lord.
Always giving thanks for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

sections.title: Concerning humility and the leadership of a household.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራት ለባልንጀሮቻችሁ ራሳችሁን ዝቅ አድርጉ።
ሴቶችም ለጌታችን እንደሚታዘዙ ለባሎቻቸው ይታዘዙ።
ክርስቶስ አካሉ ለሆነችው ቤተ ክርስቲያን ራስዋ አዳኝዋም እንደ ሆነ ወንድ ለሴት ራስዋ ነውና።
ቤተ ክርስቲያን ለክርስቶስ እንደምትታዘዝ፥ እንዲሁም ሴቶች ለባሎቻቸው በሁሉ ይታዘዙ።
ወንዶችም ክርስቶስ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እንደ ወደዳት፥ ራሱንም ስለ እርስዋ ቤዛ አድርጎ እንደ ሰጠላት ሚስቶቻቸውን ይውደዱ።
በውኃ ጥምቀትና በቃሉ ይቀድሳትና ያነጻት ዘንድ፥
የነጻችና የተቀደሰች ትሆን ዘንድ እንጂ በላይዋ እድፈት ወይም ርኵሰት እንዳያገኝባት፥ ቤተ ክርስቲያኑን ለእርሱ የከበረች ያደርጋት ዘንድ፤
እንዲሁም ወንዶች ሚስቶቻቸውን እንደ ራሳቸው አድርገው ይውደዱ፤ ሚስቱንም የወደደ ራሱን ወደደ።
ከቶ ሥጋውን መጥላት የሚቻለው የለም፤ ክርስቶስ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እንደ መገባት መግቡ፤ ጠብቁም።
እኛ የአካሉ ሕዋሳት ነንና።
"Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and they shall become one flesh."
"This is a great mystery; but I speak concerning Christ and the church."

"Likewise you husbands, dwell with them with understanding, giving honor to the wife, as to the weaker vessel; and as being heirs together of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered."
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is fitting.
In the law, this is the first commandment with a promise: "Honor your father and your mother."
That it may be well with you, and that you may live long on the earth.
And you, fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the training and admonition of the Lord.

sections.title: Concerning the servants and their overseers.

verses.text: And servants, in your flesh, as you serve your masters, do so with fear and trembling, with a sincere heart, as you serve Christ.
As you do the will of God, be as servants of Christ, not as pleasing men, for that is not the way of the Lord.
Not for men, but as you serve God, with your whole being, serve them in love and with a good will.
Whether as a master or as a servant, all that is done well shall be valued before God, as you know.

And you, masters, do not provoke your servants, but grant them forgiveness, and do what is right towards them; for you know that there is a Lord in heaven who does not show favoritism towards them or you.
እንግዲህስ ወዲህ በእግዚአብሔርና በኀይሉ ጽናት በርቱ።
የሰይጣንን ተንኰል መቋቋም እንድትችሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ጋሻ ልበሱ።
ሰልፋችሁ፦ ከጨለማ ገዦች ጋርና ከሰማይ በታች ካሉ ከክፉዎች አጋንንት ጋር ነው እንጂ ከሥጋዊና ከደማዊ ጋር አይደለምና።
ስለዚህም በክፉ ቀን መቃወም እንድትችሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ጋሻ ያዙ፤ እንድትጸኑም በሁሉ የተዘጋጃችሁ ሁኑ።
እንግዲህ ወገባችሁን በእውነት ታጥቃችሁ ቁሙ፤ የጽድቅንም ጥሩር ልበሱ።
የሰላም ወንጌል ኀይልንም ተጫምታችሁ ቁሙ።
ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር የሚንበለበሉ የክፉን ፍላፃዎች ሁሉ ማጥፋት እንድትችሉ የእምነትን ጋሻ አንሡ።
የመዳንንም የራስ ቍር በራሳችሁ ላይ ጫኑ፤ የመንፈስ ቅዱስንም ሰይፍ ያዙ፤ ይኸውም የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ነው።
በጸሎትና በምልጃ ሁሉ ዘወትር በመንፈስ ጸልዩ፤ ከዚህም ጋር ስለ ቅዱሳን ሁሉ ለመጸለይ ሁልጊዜ ትጉ፤
ለእኔም፦ ቃልን እንዲሰጠኝ፥ አፌንም ከፍቼ የወንጌልን ምሥጢር በግልጥ እንድናገር ጸልዩልኝ።
Concerning the Gospel, I am a messenger of Christ: pray that I may speak clearly as it is fitting for me to do so.
And you, that you may know my tidings, our beloved brother Tychicus, a faithful minister of God, shall make known to you all that I do.
That you may know my tidings, and that your hearts may be encouraged, therefore I have sent to you.
From our Father, from God, and from our Lord Jesus Christ, may peace and love be with our brethren in faith.
May grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
